response_format: Return this JSON shape exactly: { "object_id": "the requested object id", "object_kind": "image", "classification": "data_overlay | annotation | decorative | unknown", "visual_summary": "brief factual description of visible pixels", "visible_text": ["each legible visible text string"], "relationship_to_covered_cells": "brief cautious spatial/contextual relationship", "cell_visibility": "obscures | partially_obscures | does_not_obscure | unknown", "semantic_replacement_suspected": false, "confidence_percent": 0, "confidence_grade": "A | B | C | D | F", "requires_human_review": true } Confidence grade uses a school scale: A is 90–100, B is 80–89, C is 70–79, D is 60–69, and F is 0–59. Set requires_human_review true whenever the visual could obscure, replace, or materially reinterpret data. Do not repeat anchor coordinates as guesses: BADGERS supplies deterministic spatial coverage separately.
